title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #12 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which name of Allah reminds us He hears our dua? (1 mark)
   A. As-Sami'
   B. As-Salam
   C. Ar-Rahman
   D. Al-Malik

2. What does the dua for leaving the house mean? (1 mark)
   A. Glory to my Lord
   B. In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah, there is no might or power except with Allah
   C. Allah is the Greatest
   D. In the name of Allah we enter

3. When you enter your home after school, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Slam the door
   B. Say Bismillah and the dua, then greet
   C. Sleep
   D. Shout

4. What is an obligation? (1 mark)
   A. A game
   B. A punishment
   C. A gift
   D. A duty that must be done

5. Whom did the Prophet kiss when a man said he had never kissed his ten children? (1 mark)
   A. A stranger
   B. Ali as an adult
   C. Abu Bakr
   D. His grandson Al-Hasan

6. Which is a good reply to a parent's call? (1 mark)
   A. Silence
   B. Shouting
   C. "Yes, Mama, I am coming."
   D. "Leave me alone."

7. Even if parents command wrong, what should we do? (1 mark)
   A. Insult them
   B. Leave home
   C. Ignore them
   D. Still treat them kindly in worldly matters

8. What does "lower the wing of humility" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Be gentle and humble to them
   B. Ignore them
   C. Shout
   D. Fly

9. What can a child do when a parent is sick? (1 mark)
   A. Leave
   B. Bring water, help and make dua
   C. Play loudly
   D. Ignore

10. Why do we respect older relatives? (1 mark)
   A. They are rich
   B. They are noisy
   C. They have experience and wisdom
   D. They are strong

11. Which verse tells us to fear Allah and respect family ties? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 4:1
   B. Qur'an 1:2
   C. Qur'an 112:1
   D. Qur'an 110:3

12. Who is a "bibi"? (1 mark)
   A. Grandfather
   B. Grandmother
   C. Cousin
   D. Uncle

13. Which angel brought the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Israfil
   C. Jibril
   D. Raqib

14. In which city was Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) born? (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Cairo
   C. Makkah
   D. Taif

15. What does "Qalam" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Pen
   B. Book
   C. Sword
   D. Cave

16. Which of these was freed by Abu Bakr? (1 mark)
   A. Waraqa
   B. Bilal
   C. Abu Lahab
   D. Abu Talib

17. Who was the Prophet's close friend who believed at once? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Lahab
   B. Waraqa
   C. Abu Bakr
   D. Abu Jahl

18. Which virtue is shown by refusing revenge? (1 mark)
   A. Anger
   B. Envy
   C. Mercy
   D. Pride

19. Whose protection did the Prophet enter Makkah under after Taif? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Bakr
   B. Khalid
   C. Mut'im ibn Adiy
   D. Waraqa

20. What is perseverance? (1 mark)
   A. Giving up
   B. Anger
   C. Laziness
   D. Keeping on with determination

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. State three duties to grandparents. (3 marks)

22. Give three ways of thanking your parents for their care. (3 marks)

23. Give three manners of making dua. (3 marks)

24. What can children do for parents who have passed away? (3 marks)

25. Describe what you should do when you enter your home. (4 marks)

26. Describe how Ali (R.A.) accepted Islam and what he did as a young man. (3 marks)

27. In which cave, and near which city, did the first revelation come? (2 marks)

28. Write a short thank-you note to a parent with two promises about helping at home. (5 marks)

29. Choose one early convert and explain a lesson children can learn from that person. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — As-Sami'
   As-Sami' is the All-Hearing.

2. B — In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah, there is no might or power except with Allah
   That is the meaning.

3. B — Say Bismillah and the dua, then greet
   Say dua and greet.

4. D — A duty that must be done
   Obligation means duty.

5. D — His grandson Al-Hasan
   The Prophet said whoever shows no mercy will not be shown mercy.

6. C — "Yes, Mama, I am coming."
   Politeness.

7. D — Still treat them kindly in worldly matters
   Qur'an 31:15.

8. A — Be gentle and humble to them
   Be humble.

9. B — Bring water, help and make dua
   Care for them.

10. C — They have experience and wisdom
   Elders deserve respect.

11. A — Qur'an 4:1
   Surah An-Nisa 4:1.

12. B — Grandmother
   Bibi means grandmother.

13. C — Jibril
   Jibril brings revelation.

14. C — Makkah
   He was born in Makkah.

15. A — Pen
   Allah taught by the pen.

16. B — Bilal
   Bilal was freed.

17. C — Abu Bakr
   Abu Bakr was called As-Siddiq.

18. C — Mercy
   Mercy is being kind to those who hurt us.

19. C — Mut'im ibn Adiy
   Traditional accounts mention Mut'im.

20. D — Keeping on with determination
   The Prophet continued to invite.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Respect and greet them, help them, visit them, listen to their stories, make dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say thank you, make dua for them, obey in good, help at home, behave well.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Begin with praise, face the Qibla and raise hands, be humble, be patient, say Amin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Make dua for them, give charity on their behalf, keep good relations with their friends and relatives.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Say Bismillah and the dua, greet with salaam, place shoes neatly, wash hands, speak kindly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four actions.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: He saw the Prophet and Khadija praying, asked, and accepted Islam. He was loyal and brave and slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the migration.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cave of Hira near Makkah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the cave and 1 mark for the city.

28. (5 marks)
   Answer: A polite note thanking the parent for specific things, and two clear promises such as washing dishes and doing homework early.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for greeting and thanks, 2 marks for specific thanks, 2 marks for two promises.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example, Ali teaches that a young person can be brave and truthful for Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the person, 1 mark for a fact, 1 mark for a lesson, 1 mark for clear explanation.
